mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST meet the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately driving higher corporate margins but also inflation risk, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of three consecutive months with UNRATE below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) increase of more than 1% while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously falls by more than 0.3 percentage points signals a synchronized expansion in supply and labor utilization, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 1% AND UNRATE change < -0.3pp in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO and UNRATE meet the specified co-movement in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% combined with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for three consecutive months signals a low-inflation, low-rate environment that reduces discount rates and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2% AND FEDFUNDS < 1% for 3 consecutive months
regime_hint: low inflation and low rates regime
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS meet the specified thresholds for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) alongside a concurrent rise in retail sales (RSAFS growth > 0.4%) signals strengthening consumer demand, which should drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% AND RSAFS growth > 0.4% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) when both PAYEMS and RSAFS meet the specified growth thresholds in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.4 percentage points for two consecutive months signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases wage growth and cost pressures, ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to margin compression.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods of two consecutive months with UNRATE falling by more than 0.4 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) contraction of more than 1% while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously rises by more than 0.3 percentage points signals a recessionary supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO change < -1% AND UNRATE change > 0.3pp in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO and UNRATE co-move in the specified recessionary direction within the same month.
